*For a moment, the victim remembers a pain that has not happened yet.*

**Target:** One visible creature within 5 squares. **Player defense:** Reason. **Damage type:** mental.

**Spell:** Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Answering Lament

*Its outline shudders with the injury and a grieving note rises from somewhere behind the attacker.*

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, one visible attacker within 3 squares that can hear it gains Frightened 2 of this creature. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A translucent human figure in rain-soaked clothing, its expression fixed between grief and accusation. Details of its appearance belong to the last unresolved moments of its life.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Anchor Bound:** Its rain-soaked letter identifies the witness. Reading it aloud while holding it costs Main and removes the ghost’s physical DR until the reader’s next turn. Repetition renews, not stacks. A summoned ghost has no anchor; dies at 0 normally.

**Healing:** Spirit: ordinary magical HP healing applies; potions cannot be swallowed.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** One room remains cold and wet whatever the weather.

**Purpose:** Have the truth of its death heard.

**Tactics and retreat:** Pass through a wall to escape pressure, then use a mind-hammering accusation.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Find the person or evidence named in its repeated question.

**Habitat:** House; ruin · **Communication:** Languages known in life

**Loot:** Revealing the truth may open an inheritance or hidden cache.

**Summoning:** Spirit 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/sorrow-ghost.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-sorrow-ghost


**Category:** Spirit · **Role:** Haunter · **CV:** 25

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 2/3/5

**Reference type:** mental

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.65

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.55 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.404, O=3.653. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [anchor bound](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/anchor-bound.md), [Answering Lament](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/answering-lament.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [mind hammer](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/mind-hammer.md), [spectral passage](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/spectral-passage.md).

The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
